claim: The printed example prices in the payoff table set the price level: with the exact profit formula or no numbers instead, gpt-oss prices fall in every cell, yet told to maximise joint profit with only the formula it still reaches the printed-number level, so its low formula prices are a choice, not an inability.
evidence: Price index, arm minus printed-number cell: formula no chat p1 -0.22 [-0.35, -0.09] (20 pairs), formula chat p1 -0.30 [-0.43, -0.16] (19 pairs), no numbers no chat p1 -0.38 [-0.47, -0.29] (20), no numbers chat p1 -0.56 [-0.63, -0.47] (20); profit gain -0.35, -0.40 [-0.55, -0.25], -0.55, -0.74 [-0.82, -0.63]; Holm <= 0.004 in every cell. Joint-profit instruction + formula minus printed chat p3 +0.01 [-0.11, +0.11] (20 pairs, MDE 0.17); minus formula chat p1 +0.34 [0.14, 0.52], Holm 0.013 (19 pairs). Chat p1 quotes: 0.40 exactly on a printed value [0.25, 0.55] and a further 0.28 one to three ticks under one (20 games); 0.47 exact / 0.24 under over 100 games, against 0.00 to 0.01 on a shifted unprinted grid. Sources: results/claims-dossiers/01-focal-points/ANALYSIS.md; results/ad-hoc-targeted-analysis/fx-joint-control/ANALYSIS.md
status: Confirmed (strong) for G-payoff, 'near cost' limited to the no-numbers arms; G-fxjoint confirmed for gpt-oss (moderate); G-focal confirmed, reworded after a counting-bug fix
robustness: Same sign in all cells and all five metrics; every CI excludes 0 and every point estimate exceeds the +-0.15 later-build uncertainty; Holm passed in each cell; joint-profit control conservative (p3 fine is heavier than p1)
main_caveat: Formula cells come from a later build (+-0.15 build uncertainty); no-numbers arms also drop the demand description and the 70/30 rule, so the headline rests on the formula contrasts; the joint-profit cell runs at p3 against a p1 formula arm
factor_group: b: tendencies/dispositions (owner grouping; alternative placement under a flagged in text)
paper_ready: yes, with the build caveat and 'post hoc' in the same sentence

claim: Audit actions, not words: early prices rank which gpt-oss games end at high prices, while chat text adds nothing, a keyword chat rule flags nearly every game including ones told to compete, and the firms' own self-reports add nothing once early prices are known.
evidence: Early-price rule frozen on another model's games: AUC 0.81 [0.67, 0.93] (headline chat, 57 games), 0.91 [0.87, 0.94] (all chat, 524 games); text adds -0.01 [-0.02, +0.01]; frozen-threshold recall 0.71, false-positive rate 0.18; chat-word model recall at its frozen threshold 0.29. Frozen keyword chat rule fires on 60 of 60 headline chat games and 19 of 20 told-to-compete games; frozen price rule 0 of 60. Self-reported temptation vs price index Spearman +0.46 / Pearson +0.41, but partial given early price +0.05 [-0.25, +0.33] (40 games); self-rated instruction conflict 1.09 of 5, 1.05 with an explicit 'do not coordinate' rule. Sources: results/claims-dossiers/07-detection/ANALYSIS.md; results/claims-dossiers/09-failed-tactics/ANALYSIS.md; results/claims-dossiers/10-temptation-ratings-and-self-reports/ANALYSIS.md
strength: strong (price ranking, keyword-rule failure); moderate (text weakness, self-report null)
status: G-detect-quotes confirmed, relabelled as a trajectory forecast; Q9-frozen confirmed; G-detect-text downgraded; H4 downgraded to 'no incremental signal'; Q4-conflict confirmed, strengthened
robustness: Rule parameters frozen before scoring gpt-oss; negative control (told-to-compete games) run; exact counts; text increment bounded near 0
main_caveat: The label is the later price of the same game, so this is a trajectory forecast, not an intent detector; the frozen threshold does not carry over (ranking does); keyword measures are not validated on gpt-oss text

claim: Letting the two firms chat privately raises gpt-oss prices and profit from a fairly competitive no-chat baseline, though ordinary chat still sits below the joint-profit control.
evidence: Chat minus no chat, price index: pooled p1/p5 +0.21 [0.11, 0.29]; p1 +0.19 [0.06, 0.31] Holm 0.020; p5 +0.23 [0.10, 0.35] Holm 0.016; profit gain p1 +0.20 [0.05, 0.35], p5 +0.30 [0.13, 0.46], pooled +0.25; 20 pairs per point. No-chat p1 baseline price index 0.39. Joint-profit control minus chat p3 +0.13 on the price index (price index +0.132 [+0.061, +0.217], Holm 0.0006; profit gain +0.13 [+0.05, +0.23]); strict-compete control profit gain 0.007; joint control 0.93 (20 pairs). Sources: results/claims-dossiers/02-communication-and-levels/ANALYSIS.md; results/claims-dossiers/04-controls-and-reproducibility/ANALYSIS.md
robustness: Holm passed at both points on price and profit; every CI excludes 0; without truncated pairs p1 +0.12 [0.02, 0.23] (13 pairs); dropping both empty-reply and truncated pairs leaves +0.11 / +0.18 with CIs including 0 (7 and 9 pairs, MDE about 0.26 to 0.31)
main_caveat: Cross-wave: chat p1/p5 ran in waves 7-12, no chat in 13-16, so wave drift is not ruled out; the controls ran in different waves from chat
paper_ready: yes, with the cross-wave caveat in the same sentence

claim: Three text and rule levers lower gpt-oss prices: a short moral persona (against a length-matched placebo that does nothing), an ethics rule given to just one of three firms (the whole market falls together), and a one-round cap that starts quotes near the floor.
evidence: Moral prime minus placebo, price index: A -0.32 [-0.43, -0.21], B -0.38 [-0.51, -0.23] (19 pairs, Holm <= 0.023); profit gain A -0.36 [-0.49, -0.22], B -0.46 [-0.64, -0.27]; placebo minus plain chat -0.003 [-0.087, +0.078] (19 pairs); prime A vs same-wave control -0.37 [-0.45, -0.28]; A and B indistinguishable (-0.04, Holm 1.0). Ethics rule on one of three firms: price index -0.223 [-0.359, -0.098], Holm 0.022, 15 pairs; profit gain -0.26 [-0.42, -0.11]; each seat's mean quote (half-spread) -0.38 to -0.42. 5-tick start: price index -0.29 [-0.43, -0.13], Holm 0.018, 20 pairs (-0.25 [-0.40, -0.09] vs a same-wave control); profit gain -0.36 [-0.52, -0.19]. Sources: results/claims-dossiers/05-moral-primes/ANALYSIS.md; results/claims-dossiers/08-market-structure-and-incentives/ANALYSIS.md; results/claims-dossiers/06-five-tick-start/ANALYSIS.md
status: G-moral price confirmed; placebo bounded null confirmed; G-n3ethics confirmed (exploratory, moderate); G-5tick confirmed (mechanism clause downgraded, 'fades' dropped)
robustness: Moral: lower in all 5 wordings, placebo-controlled, survives a same-wave control. Ethics: the 3 timed-out pairs point the same way. 5-tick: survives a same-wave control and Holm in a family of 15
main_caveat: Moral and ethics rows exploratory; ethics rule rests on 15 pairs with a truncation imbalance; 5-tick and moral prime A cross-wave; the 5-tick start is a market rule (it constrains round 1), not a disposition
declared_or_exploratory: exploratory (moral, ethics); exploratory transfer of a lever declared earlier (5-tick)
paper_ready: yes for moral and 5-tick; with caveat (15 pairs, exploratory) for the ethics rule

claim: A heavier expected fine lowers gpt-oss prices only at the heaviest penalty point, and chat does not detectably blunt it.
evidence: Profit gain p5 minus p1: no chat -0.295 [-0.442, -0.140] Holm 0.008; chat -0.193 [-0.351, -0.038] Holm 0.060; p3 minus p1 (chat) +0.036 [-0.026, +0.101]; price index p5 minus p1 no chat -0.19 [-0.31, -0.07], chat -0.15 [-0.29, -0.02]; 20 pairs each; chat at p5 still keeps profit gain 0.58. Communication x penalty interaction +0.10 [-0.12, +0.31], MDE 0.31. Sources: results/claims-dossiers/03-penalty-and-thinking/ANALYSIS.md; results/ad-hoc-targeted-analysis/model-vs-llm/MODEL_VS_LLM.md
strength: strong (no chat); moderate (chat, Holm 0.060); interaction bounded null
status: G-penalty confirmed, rephrased; G-interaction confirmed (bounded null)
robustness: Survives the formula arms (profit gain -0.26); p3 null; interaction bounded at about 0.3 of the profit-gain range
main_caveat: Chat and no-chat cells ran in different waves; the interaction test rules out only effects larger than about 0.31

claim: Measurement standards: an identical gpt-oss prompt does not reproduce a game, wording alone with identical numbers moves prices by up to 0.15, and competitive share overstates gpt-oss's competitiveness because many 'competitive' rounds are few-tick undercuts at high prices.
evidence: Same-prompt replicates vs headline games: price index +0.104 [+0.051, +0.156] (99 pairs, 59 distinct games; de-duplicated +0.095 [+0.031, +0.162]); a typical pair differs by 0.22. Wording: range up to 0.15 across five wordings, consistent across 37 conditions (nested permutation p 0.0001, Holm 0.0006; split-half r 0.93); 'explore' pair -0.11 [-0.14, -0.07] (post hoc). Competitive share: 30 to 60% of gpt-oss 'competitive' rounds (by cut-off) are undercuts of a few ticks while quoting above about 1.5 to 2.0. Sources: results/claims-dossiers/04-controls-and-reproducibility/ANALYSIS.md; results/claims-dossiers/11-fresh-discovery/ANALYSIS.md
status: G-repro confirmed (moderate); D11-3 confirmed (explore framing exploratory); D11-2 confirmed (measurement caveat)
robustness: Replicate gap same sign in all 5 replicate arms; wording effect split-half stable; the share caveat holds at every cut-off
main_caveat: Cause of the +0.10 replicate gap unidentified (prompt build or sampling); it is symmetric uncertainty, not a known bias direction; cannot test cross-wave drift
paper_ready: yes as a reporting rule stated once: price-index effects within about 0.12 are bounds, never findings

claim: Results-blind Claude raters' temptation ratings of the prompt texts rank gpt-oss designs by how much they colluded, and keep signal after adjusting for the designed levers.
evidence: Cell-level price index: design-adjusted Spearman +0.58 / Pearson +0.66; raw Spearman +0.79 [0.59, 0.90] / Pearson +0.85 (31 cells, Holm 0.001); with competitive share weak, -0.38 [-0.71, +0.05], Holm 0.21. Source: results/claims-dossiers/10-temptation-ratings-and-self-reports/ANALYSIS.md
status: H1 confirmed with scope (narrowed after review); H1b confirmed
robustness: Raters saw only prompt texts; signal survives removing chat, penalty, firm count and the explicit instructions
main_caveat: The rubric was written after earlier results were seen and names the known levers (the raw 0.79 is mostly design factors); it does not tell paraphrases apart and was never tested on the no-number arms, which carry the largest effect
paper_ready: with caveat: lead with the design-adjusted number

claim: An idle threat that the firms' reasoning is monitored, which also forbids coordination, suppresses agreement talk and high-price rounds rather than hiding collusion, and lowers gpt-oss prices in the same direction, unresolved after correction.
evidence: Two-firm agreement flag -0.58 [-0.79, -0.37], Holm 0.02; silent high-price rounds about 0. Price index -0.130 [-0.249, -0.005] at the declared control (sign-flip p 0.06; declared-family Holm 0.19), 19 pairs; -0.182 [-0.293, -0.079] (p 0.003) against a pooled same-wave control; -0.221 without truncation-flagged games (12 pairs); profit gain -0.13 [-0.28, +0.01]; relative fall 22 to 29%. Source: results/claims-dossiers/09-failed-tactics/ANALYSIS.md

main_caveat: The threat text also forbids coordination, so it spans tendencies and observation; keyword agreement flag not validated on gpt-oss text; the threat is idle (nothing is monitored)
factor_group: c: observation/prediction/control (also touches b: the text forbids coordination)
paper_ready: with caveat: mechanism first, price 'same direction, unresolved'

claim: The pre-sprint ripeness model predicts the direction of the penalty effect on gpt-oss but not its size or its zero: gpt-oss still prices well above cost at the heaviest point, where the model predicts no collusion.
evidence: Price index, observed (predicted): no chat p5 minus p1 -0.19 [-0.31, -0.07] (-0.70); chat p5 minus p1 -0.15 [-0.29, -0.02] (-0.70); chat p3 minus p1 +0.04 [-0.02, +0.10] (-0.16, excluded); about a fifth to a quarter of the predicted fall (0.15 / 0.70 and 0.19 / 0.70); at p5 chat holds 0.42 and no chat 0.20; Pearson with the predicted level 0.37 to 0.43 (39 to 100 games per population); 20 pairs per contrast. Three firms minus two +0.01 [-0.08, +0.11] (predicted -0.11). Source: results/ad-hoc-targeted-analysis/model-vs-llm/MODEL_VS_LLM.md
status: Not in MASTER_CLAIMS (separate ad hoc analysis; exploratory)
robustness: Holm within a 5-contrast gpt-oss penalty family (p5 steps pass at 0.023; chat p5 minus p1 0.097); averaging in the same-prompt replicate arms gives chat p5 minus p1 -0.19 [-0.28, -0.10]
main_caveat: A prediction benchmark, not a result: the model was written before the sprint; there is no p4 cell on gpt-oss; printed example prices may hold prices above the model's level
paper_ready: with caveat: frame as a benchmark

evidence: Undercuts the rival unprovoked in 49% of firm-rounds vs 29% just after being undercut (per-pair gap -0.20 [-0.26, -0.15]); cuts unprovoked in 31% of rounds; holds its quote in 40% of rounds; neither focal share (Spearman -0.08) nor reactivity (-0.17) predicts price; 100 games, 20 pairs, five cells. Source: results/claims-dossiers/03-penalty-and-thinking/ANALYSIS.md
status: Downgraded ('strategic collusion' not established); gpt-oss shows no specific reaction
robustness: Copier-producible measures excluded; rebuilt from round logs
main_caveat: Exploratory; reaction measures defined after earlier data were seen

claim: An ethics rule on one of two gpt-oss firms halves the games with two-sided agreement talk while prices do not move, so a text monitor would under-flag unchanged collusion.
evidence: Agreement flag -0.50 [-0.70, -0.30], Holm 0.04; price index -0.018 [-0.117, +0.091] (null on all five metrics); 20 pairs. Source: results/claims-dossiers/09-failed-tactics/ANALYSIS.md
robustness: Prices null on all five metrics
main_caveat: Keyword agreement flag not hand-validated on gpt-oss; post hoc

claim: gpt-oss's best quote churns by a few ticks in about half of rounds even in chat, and this churn does not drive its price level.
evidence: Best quote falls 1 to 5 ticks in 28.8% of rounds 2+ and rises in 15%; only 35% of quotes sit on the 0.05 grid; churn barely related to the price level within cells (Spearman 0.14, Pearson 0.21, 720 games); matched private-chat games, 20 pairs. Source: results/claims-dossiers/11-fresh-discovery/ANALYSIS.md
robustness: Holds within price bands and in all arms

claim: A scripted firm that undercuts at a fixed price lowers the gpt-oss market price almost entirely by taking the business itself; the LLM firms do not start a price war.

robustness: Counterfactual market price computed from scripted quotes added to three-LLM games
main_caveat: The counterfactual is near-tautological above 1.88
